desc: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. They have 3 charges. While wearing them, you can expend 1 or more charges to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCharmPerso]{Charm Person} (save DC 13). For 1 charge, you cast the level 1 version of the spell. You increase the spell's level by one for each additional charge you expend. The lenses regain all expended charges daily at dawn.
name: eyes of charming
